summary.text: Beth Fuller is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 53 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Deborah Silcox (R).
A public health professional and first-time candidate, she says her priorities include Medicaid expansion and affordable healthcare.

paragraphs.text: Beth Fuller earned a bachelor's degree from Emory University and a Ph.D. from Columbia University, and also studied at the University of Alabama at Birmingham.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a lifelong Georgian, public health professional and mother, and said she grew up with a father who was a judge.
She said her contract with the CDC was terminated in 2024 as a result of federal funding cuts, which led her to run for office.
Fuller said she would support Medicaid expansion and more affordable healthcare, take on insurance companies over premiums, and advocate for fully funded public schools and gun policy changes.
She advanced from the Democratic primary on May 19, 2026.
